verdict.rationale: Visa publishes detailed REST API docs with versioned endpoints (e.g., POST /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens) and field-level requirements, plus a public Trusted Agent Protocol spec with cryptographic standards (RFC9421) and a runnable open-source reference implementation (agent-registry, cdn-proxy for signature verification, tap-agent) that developers can use to validate conformance. A sandbox environment lets developers test against the live API. However, there is no evidence of a formal published schema artifact (e.g., OpenAPI/JSON Schema) or a dedicated conformance test suite/certification tool beyond the TAP reference implementation and sandbox. Missing for 10: an explicit machine-readable schema (OpenAPI/JSON Schema), a formal versioning policy across protocol versions, and a standalone conformance/validation test harness beyond sandbox testing and TAP's signature verification proxy.
